explication: ARC is a Kubernetes operator for provisioning, registering, and autoscaling ephemeral or persistent GitHub Actions runners. Users submit runner scale-set or legacy runner resources to Kubernetes; controllers reconcile those resources into listener objects, runner objects, pods, secrets, and volumes. GitHub workflow demand drives scale decisions through the scale-set listener or legacy webhook/HRA path, while GitHub APIs provide registration and workflow data. Metrics and webhook-forwarding services are separate operational integrations. Several controller internals and listener implementations were not sampled, so only documented or source-supported links are shown.
